title: Заморозить package-boundary contract и target API manifests
summary: Создать один normative package-boundary contract и machine-readable target roster для PHP core, Dart core/testkit и Dart MCP companion, классифицировав каждый текущий symbol/export до переносов.
why: PHP PSR-4 сейчас делает достижимыми все `AgenTools\\**` и `AgenTools\\Reference\\**`, а Dart main barrel реэкспортирует in-memory/fixed implementations; reachability не является осознанным stability promise. `RAG:—`.

include: Deterministic current inventories from Composer classmap/PSR-4 and transitive Dart exports; target classifications `stable`, `advanced`, `testkit`, `reference`, `internal`; package/import/symbol identity; production consumer and behavioural-test proof; introduced/deprecated/replacement metadata; cross-tier dependency rules; archive role; P1 migration/guarantee and P6 semantic links; complete delta disposition.
exclude: Moving source; changing manifests/exports; declaring a symbol stable without a production consumer; public registry/license decisions; inventing P2–P6 API before predecessor execution; automatic source generation.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: `package-boundary-v1.md` owns taxonomy and dependency rules; `api/package-surface-v1.json` owns the exact target entries, never a second handwritten Markdown list. Every reachable current entry has exactly one target disposition and evidence. `stable` requires an explicit package export/autoload classification, one production consumer and one behavioural test. Candidate reachability may become internal/testkit only when no stable evidence exists and P1 compatibility permits it; a proved stable removal needs a compatibility shim/deprecation or a new finite owner-gate. Tool output is deterministic, sorted, source-digested and separates `current`, `target`, and `delta`.
guidance: Implement `inventory`, `validate-contract`, and `diff --actual` subcommands using stdlib only. PHP discovery reads Composer metadata plus tokenized declarations and fails on ambiguous FQNs; Dart discovery resolves export graphs including `show`/`hide` and cycles without treating direct `lib/src` imports as supported API. Cross-tier graph rejects core→testkit/reference/optional-adapter edges. Do not infer stability from visibility alone.

validation.expect: Source acceptance condition preserved in Validation section.

deliverables: Versioned boundary policy, exact target package-surface contract, deterministic inventory/diff tool and repository-grounded current→target migration report.
